method.name: MAXIMUM_VERIFIED_EVOLUTIONARY_GAIN
method.selection_rule: Prefer a bounded causal change that closes the largest independent uncertainty cone, unlocks the most downstream gates, preserves already-green gates, and has an exact rollback/replay path.

dmaic.define: Freeze exact heads and failing gates before mutation.
dmaic.measure: Read exact workflow/job/tree evidence and preserve scoped PASS/FAIL separately.
dmaic.analyze: Collapse failures onto earliest common causes; do not patch downstream symptoms independently.
dmaic.improve: Apply the smallest causal set of changes that can close multiple dependent failures without changing unrelated behavior.
dmaic.control: Require PR CI, exact-head receipts, non-regression of already-green gates, and exact rollback references before promotion.
